scope: Tongxin upstream auth/bootstrap for EcoreX safe-tool xin_agent_cli.py bootstrap
changes: Tongxin Flask service now exposes POST /xin-agent/ecorex/auth for EcoreX Admin API upstream login forwarding.
Tongxin Flask service now exposes protected GET /xin-agent/ecorex/bootstrap/manifest and GET /xin-agent/ecorex/bootstrap/xin_agent_cli.py.
Tongxin auth validates existing Tongxin users with models.verify_user, rejects non-read-only requests, rate-limits login attempts, and never returns passwords.
Bootstrap tokens are short-lived HMAC-signed bearer tokens and are required for both manifest and script download.
EcoreX Admin API now points to the Tongxin upstream auth endpoint and forwards with a service-to-service bearer token.
EcoreX Admin API now preserves upstream HTTP error status and JSON payloads for Tongxin auth failures instead of wrapping upstream 401 responses as 500.
knownOperationalNote: A no-deps Docker image rebuild attempt was stopped because it exceeded the interactive command timeout; the production web container was safely force-recreated for env loading and then hot-patched with the updated app.py, config.py, test, and xin_agent_cli.py from the updated host source.
The project .dockerignore already excludes backups/ and data/; a future full rebuild should be run from a controlled maintenance shell if needed.
